title: Axiom Debt File Schema
description: JSON Schema for all Axiom debt-tracking JSON files: architecture_debt.json, debt_registry.json, and debt_ledger.json.

severityEnum.description: Canonical debt severity level. Prefer these values for new entries.

statusEnum.description: Canonical lifecycle status. Prefer these values for new entries.

iso8601String.description: ISO 8601 datetime string with UTC 'Z' suffix (e.g. 2026-06-18T13:27:57Z).

debtId.description: Canonical debt identifier (DEBT#NNN or higher, or legacy DEBT-CI#NNN).

fileRef.description: Relative file or directory path within the project.

contentHash.description: Content hash of the tracked file (hex digest or signed integer string).

ArchitectureDebtFile.description: Schema for data/architecture_debt.json — per-file debt tracking.

ArchitectureDebtEntry.description: A single architecture debt record for one source file.

file.description: Relative path to the source file.

count.description: Number of debt items detected in this file.

firstSeen.description: Timestamp when this debt was first detected (ISO 8601) or empty if unknown.

lastSeen.description: Timestamp when this debt was last detected (ISO 8601) or empty if unknown.

contentHash.description: Content hash of the file at last scan.

DebtRegistryFile.description: Schema for data/debt_registry.json — canonical SSOT for tracked debts.

$schema.description: JSON Schema draft URI (structural metadata only, not validated as a keyword).

$comment.description: Human-readable schema note for tools that do not consume formal validation.

generatedAt.description: UTC generation timestamp (ISO 8601), or null when the registry was hand-maintained.

DebtRegistryEntry.description: A single canonical debt record in the registry.

category.description: Debt category (e.g. Compiler Hygiene, Architecture / SoC).

files.description: Live-target references — existence is enforced by debt_engine --validate for open/deferred entries. May be empty or absent for system-wide issues; line annotations (e.g. src/foo.nim:12-34) are permitted and do not affect existence.

historicalFiles.description: Historical-record references — existence exempt (live-target refs live in `files`).

file.description: Single-file alias used by theater skip matching.

severity.description: Severity level; prefer canonical values from severityEnum but freeform values like 'info' or 'n/a' are allowed.

source.description: Origin of the debt entry (e.g. markdown, lint, gate).

status.description: Lifecycle status; prefer canonical values from statusEnum but freeform annotations are allowed.

resolution.description: Resolution status — freeform (e.g. FIXED, WONT_FIX, UNRESOLVED, or long-form policy notes).

lastVerifiedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this entry was last verified.

resolvedAt.description: When the entry was resolved — ISO 8601 datetime or date-only (legacy entries).

symbol.description: Exact procedure/function/macro signature or artifact symbol.

contentHash.description: Content hash of the tracked artifact (sha256: digest).

lineRange.description: Human-readable line range hint (e.g. src/foo.nim:12-34; src/bar.nim:1-5).

binding.description: Binding-type declaration: how this entry binds to the audited artifact. Absent = legacy interpretation (nim_pragma binding — unchanged behavior, no extra requirement). "registry_disposition" = the registry entry itself is the binding medium (documented disposition for why no {.axiomDebt.} marker exists) and requires bindingRationale. Any other value — including the reserved "comment_marker" — is rejected by this enum.

bindingRationale.description: One-line reason required when binding == "registry_disposition": the reason plus explicit trace pointers (the entry's own resolution/source fields, and external doc path + item ID when applicable, e.g. ADR-0029, ADR-0038, DEBT#466-470). Must contain at least one non-whitespace character. Mechanical format validation only — it does not prove the semantic legitimacy of the disposition.

budgetCategoryEnum.description: Budget category identifier for debt_ledger.json v1.1.0 records.

severityBudgetEnum.description: Budget severity level for v1.1.0 ledger records.

statusBudgetEnum.description: Budget record lifecycle status for v1.1.0 ledger records.

resolutionEnum.description: Resolution status for v1.1.0 budget ledger records.

BudgetRecord.description: A single budget metric record in data/debt_ledger.json v1.1.0.

id.description: Aggregate budget metric identifier (e.g. BUDGET#001). NOT a registry debt identity — cross-reference debt_registry for DEBT# IDs.

category.description: Fixed discriminator value identifying this as a budget ledger record.

description.description: Human-readable description of the budget metric.

current.description: Current measured value for the metric.

source.description: Origin of the budget metric (e.g. debt_budgets.json).

lastVerifiedAt.description: ISO 8601 datetime when this record was last verified.

DebtLedgerFile.description: Schema for data/debt_ledger.json — budget metrics ledger v1.1.0.

version.description: Schema version. v1.1.0 ONLY — any other version is fail-closed rejected by all consumers.

generated.description: ISO 8601 datetime when this ledger was generated.

totalRecords.description: Number of budget records in the records array.
